fusions.name: Bellowing Screech
fusions.desc: A bellowing screech deals 14 resonating damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Mauling Draught
fusions.desc: A mauling bite that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and heals you for 35% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Torpor
fusions.desc: You fall into torpor, restoring 4 health a second for 8 seconds. The healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Hibernation Reserves
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.6 health a second.
